Return.Syntax: Single values use return expression. Multiple values use return -> (expression, expression, ...).
Return.ImplicitSuccess: Functions returning void or !void may reach the end without an explicit return. For !void this is the successful void result.
Return.ValueRequired: Every reachable path of a function returning T or !T with non-void T must return a compatible value.
Return.EndlessLoop: A while whose condition is the literal true and that no break ends (none of its own, none that names its label) never completes: what follows it is not reached, and a function may end with it. A break of a loop inside it, or one that names a loop around it, does not end it.

MlxControlFlow.Panic: Panic is not a cleanup mechanism. Defer execution is not guaranteed during panic termination.
